article.story: Virginia (3-1) at Florida State (2-2), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Virginia by 3. Against the spread: Virginia 3-1, Florida State 1-2-1. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Virginia Offense Overall: 447.3 yards per game (35th in FBS) Passing: 254.5 yards per game (52nd) Rushing: 192.8 yards per game (37th) Scoring: 40.5 points per game (19th) Virginia Defense Overall: 247 yards per game (14th in FBS) Passing: 130.3 yards per game (5th) Rushing: 116.8 yards per game (49th) Scoring: 13 points per game (16th) Florida State Offense Overall: 407.8 yards per game (69th in FBS) Passing: 235.5 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 172.3 yards per game (56th) Scoring: 32 points per game (63rd) Florida State Defense Overall: 429.8 yards per game (126th in FBS) Passing: 290 yards per game (135th) Rushing: 139.8 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 25.3 points per game (90th) Florida State ranks 123rd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 45.8% of third downs. Florida State is 80th in the FBS with a -1 turnover margin, compared to Virginia's 11th-ranked +5 margin. Florida State is 90th in the FBS averaging 61.8 penalty yards per game, compared to Virginia's 37th-ranked 48.8 per-game average. Florida State leads the FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 100% of trips. Florida State ranks 112th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:07, compared to Virginia's 9th-ranked average of 33:54. Team leaders Virginia Passing: Beau Pribula, 793 yards, 11 TDs, 1 INT, 76.7 completion percentage Rushing: Jekail Middlebrook, 177 yards on 40 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Kameron Courtney, 166 yards on 15 catches, 2 TDs Florida State Passing: Ashton Daniels, 928 yards, 6 TDs, 5 INTs, 59.8 completion percentage Rushing: Ousmane Kromah, 397 yards on 64 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Duce Robinson, 262 yards on 13 catches, 2 TDs Last game Virginia defeated Delaware 42-3 on Sept. 26. Pribula threw for 279 yards on 24-of-28 attempts (85.7%) with four touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 24 yards and one rushing touchdown. Xay Davis had 30 rushing yards on 10 carries, adding two receptions for 27 yards. Rico Flores Jr. put up 113 yards on nine catches with one touchdown. Florida State won 34-7 over Central Arkansas on Sept. 26. Daniels threw for 224 yards on 12-of-18 attempts (66.7%) with two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball three times for 34 yards. Kromah carried the ball 11 times for 86 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding one reception for 19 yards. Jayvan Boggs had six receptions for 122 yards and one touchdown. Next game Virginia hosts Syracuse on Oct. 10. Florida State plays at Louisville on Oct. 9.
